info.title: Node.js script to expand ranges 1-10 and a-z

diffs.patch:
Index: package.json
===================================================================
--- package.json	
+++ package.json	
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+{
+  "name": "expand-range",
+  "version": "1.0.0",
+  "description": "Expand ranges like '1-10' or 'a-z' into an array of values",
+  "type": "module",
+  "main": "src/expand-range.js",
+  "exports": "./src/expand-range.js",
+  "bin": {
+    "expand-range": "src/cli.js"
+  },
+  "scripts": {
+    "test": "node --test"
+  },
+  "license": "MIT"
+}

parts.text:
Done. Project set up at `/work`:

- `src/expand-range.js` — `expandRange('1-10')`, `expandRange('a-z')`, descending, negatives, single values, whitespace
- `src/cli.js` — `node src/cli.js "1-10"` prints JSON
- `test/expand-range.test.js` — 9 tests, all passing via `npm test`
- `package.json` (ESM, no deps), `.gitignore`

Usage:
```js
import { expandRange } from './src/expand-range.js';
expandRange('a-z'); // ['a', ..., 'z']
```
